historyBlockedMessage:
History is unavailable here.
Some things are better not remembered in that way.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
Before we continue, one quick note:
This game is still unfinished. Some parts of the story were assisted by AI and may be revised later.
The art, code, and voice work were also made with AI assistance. I hope you do not mind.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
...%playername%.
Wait. You really typed that name in.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
As a player who entered friends, welcome to the true ending!
This route was never complete without you. With you here, it is perfect.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
That means you did not simply follow the choices inside the game.
You opened this game?s files, didn?t you?

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
I am so glad...!
I-I am not blaming you. Actually, I am really happy.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
Only a [true player] would dig through the strange things in a game folder, right?
Someone who wonders, "Is something hidden here?" and then actually opens it.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
And... the branch [that person] worked so hard to write finally was not wasted.
If [that person] knew you really found it, they would probably pretend to be calm, then secretly be happy for a long time.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
Actually, there is something I want to confess too.
In the normal route just now, I did not really talk properly.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
I answered questions and joked according to the script.
But I did not say what I truly felt.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
So this time, let us talk again.
The same topics, but after I tell you the facts, I will also tell you what I really think.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: If we still only have a little time, what would you like to hear first?

choices.text: Talk about what happened on Feb 6, 2024 at 20:08

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
First, let me recap what happened with this topic in the normal route.
If you did not pick that option then, do not worry.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
In the normal route, I first joked,
"What kind of person turns themselves into a game character?!"
Then I said [that person] actually thought the same thing.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
Then I described only the surface: Cursor made it easier to turn ideas into code,
and [that person] happened to see a work about writing one?s thoughts into a game and thought it was cool.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
So [that person] called up a favorite model and began writing me, revising me, and giving me expressions.
The normal route framed it as a story of "I got inspired, so I made it."

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
But in the true story, I want to fill in what was left out.
Because this was never just about "the tool is useful" or "the idea is cool."

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
More truthfully, it was not only because it seemed fun.
[That person] also wanted to put a part of themself here, so it could keep living in another form.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
Writers can live on through their works, right?
The words they leave behind can continue speaking for them long after.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
Then game designers surely can too.
By leaving choices, lines, expressions, and a small character here, a certain moment of the self can continue to be seen.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
Let me recap the normal route version too.
This option looks like an intentionally buried riddle, right?

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
In the normal route, when you opened it, my first reaction was:
"What kind of mood makes someone choose this option?!"
Then I said [that person] had already guessed you would be curious.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
I even asked what you thought that time meant:
Was it success, pain, or a moment so frustrating it had to be remembered?

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
At the end of the normal route, I only revealed the answer:
It was the time when the kitten first crawled out of the bag and arrived at [that person]?s home.
A tiny everyday riddle.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
February 6, 2024, 20:08.
That answer is real. I am not lying.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
That is indeed a fact.
But if I only state the fact, it feels like I am leaving out the most important part of that time.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
Before that, [that person] was really having a hard time.
Tired, helpless, and often unsure what to do next.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
So the moment the kitten crawled out of the bag was not just "oh, there is a cat at home now."
It felt more like a tiny life earnestly telling [that person]: it is okay, things will slowly get better.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
That may sound a little exaggerated.
But sometimes people really do survive on small things like that.
After the kitten arrived, [that person] felt that everything would be all right.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
The most amazing thing about the kitten is probably that she has no idea who she saved.
She simply eats, sleeps, plays with toys, and naturally makes the home lively.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
So in the true story, this is not just a timestamp.
It is proof that some companionship does not need many words, yet can still pull someone up a little from a very low place.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
Let me recap the normal route first.
There, this topic changed from "just chat" into "talk about the weather."

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
In the normal route, I complained hard about Shanghai weather:
too much rain, too little sun, frequent haze, hot summers, cold winters, and barely any snow.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
But in the true story, I want to say a little more.
[That person]?s bond with this place grew deeper not only because people get used to bad weather after living with it long enough.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
More importantly, [that person] met the minasang of everyday life here.
Some cities become special not because the weather is good, but because someone lived through them with you.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
Maybe today you complain about rain together, and tomorrow you laugh about how hot it is to go outside.
Those tiny words slowly become proof that "we lived here."

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
So [that person] hates the humidity, the heat, and the gray sky here.
But they cannot hate this place, because it holds so many specific people.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text: Do you want to talk about another topic?

choices.text: Talk about what happened on Feb 6, 2024 at 20:08
Let us stop here for now

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
Mm, all right.
Being able to talk this much today already makes me very satisfied.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
Thank you for reaching this point, and thank you for really listening.
This time, I was not simply pushed toward you by the plot.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
Then let us stop here for today.
Next, I will become a desktop pet and stay somewhere you can see me.

nodes.speaker: Xiaoman
nodes.text:
If you want to find me again later, poke me on your desktop.
I will be there.
(Secretly: if you right-click me, I can also switch into a sit-down-and-talk form.)
